data.explanation: This notice from the German tax office (Finanzamt) updates the assessed property value (Grundsteuerwert) of your house because of the 38 m² extension built in 2025. The notice itself does not require any payment; it will be used for a separate property tax base notice (Grundsteuermessbescheid), and your municipality will then set the actual property tax (Grundsteuer) you owe. If you think the new value is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt — the app shows the deadline until when you can decide this. If you take no action, the value becomes final. Consider checking the stated extra living space, or ask a tax advisor if unsure.

items.title: Object to the new property tax value if you disagree (Einspruch gegen den Grundsteuerwertbescheid)
items.action: If you disagree with the revised property tax value, file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterweilburg, in writing, electronically, or recorded in person.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.

data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterweilburg (Bewertungsstelle Grundbesitz) informs Johanna Beispielacker that the assessed property tax value (Grundsteuerwert) of her house at Ackerstraße 26 has been revised upward to €184,300 as of 1 January 2026, due to a 38 m² extension built in 2025. The actual property tax itself will be set later by her municipality based on a following Grundsteuermessbescheid.
data.tax_note: Property tax (Grundsteuer) based on this value may be tax-deductible if the property is rented out or used for business/home-office purposes; keep this notice for that year's tax return.
